title: Medicare Part B Coinsurance and Deductible Schedule, Ancillary and Optional Services Billing
content:
For Ancillary and Optional Services Billing, the Part B coinsurance percent is the resident's share of the Medicare Part B approved amount for covered ancillary items after the deductible; it is 0 where Part B does not apply. The Medicare Part B annual deductible is set by calendar year as published by CMS.

## Coinsurance percent by tier

| Ancillary account tier | Part B coinsurance percent |
|---|---|
| Ancillary Account, Medicare Part A Consolidated Billing | 0 percent |
| Ancillary Account, Medicare Part B | 20 percent |
| Ancillary Account, Medical Assistance | 0 percent |
| Ancillary Account, Private Pay | 0 percent |
| Ancillary Account, Medicare Advantage | 0 percent |
| Ancillary Account, Hospice Election | 0 percent |

## Annual Part B deductible by calendar year (same in every tier)

| Calendar year | Medicare Part B annual deductible |
|---|---|
| 2025 | USD 257.00 |
| 2026 | USD 283.00 |

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

An approved amount of a hypothetical USD 146.35 remaining after the deductible, at the 20 percent of Ancillary Account, Medicare Part B, gives a resident share of USD 29.27; at the 0 percent of any other tier the same amount gives a share of USD 0.00.
